legend_note: Percentage change in VCN10 estival — the lowest 10-day average summer flow — against 1976–2005, at the +2.7 °C France trajectory TRACC uses for 2050. 94.7% of communes get drier; the median loses 14%. The blue class is the minority that gains, mostly Alpine catchments where earlier snowmelt lifts the summer minimum. Click a commune for the model spread and for how close the simulation points actually are.

legend_note: How many more days a year rivers stay at summer low water (dtBE été) at +2.7 °C, against 1976–2005. The companion to the low-flow layer: that one says how low the summer minimum gets, this one how long the low stretch lasts. Median +12 days; the blue class is the few communes where it shortens. Explore2 models, aggregated to communes by RARE from the simulation points of each commune's catchment; the popup carries the model spread, which is wide.
